metadata.title: Product Bricks & Streams
metadata.description: Brick map of VWE Automotive's vehicle-data and dealer SaaS platform: RDW-based vehicle data, valuation and BPM, the modular MijnVWE dealer platform, RDW and trade services, data products and APIs, and Finnik consumer channels.

rootGroups.name: Vehicle Data Foundation
rootGroups.description: The authoritative vehicle facts VWE is known for: RDW register, specification, history, market data and valuations.

subGroups.name: Registry and Identity
subGroups.description: Who and what the vehicle is.

bricks.name: RDW Registry Connector and Vehicle Register
bricks.description: Direct, authorised connection to the RDW (Dutch vehicle authority) as an officially recognised information and application provider, plus a continuously refreshed vehicle register keyed by license plate. Every plate lookup, RDW transaction and data product starts here.

modules.name: Plate Register API
modules.description: Internal lookup of registration, technical and status data by plate or VIN.

modules.name: Register Change Consumer
modules.description: Applies RDW mutation feeds (ownership changes, APK, WOK, export) to the register.

modules.name: RDW Session Monitor
modules.description: Monitors RDW channel availability, certificates and quota so transactions fail fast.

modules.name: Vehicle Register
modules.description: Plate-keyed register of registration, technical, APK and status facts with change history.

layers.description: Adapters to RDW, data partners, channels and providers.

modules.name: RDW Channel Adapter
modules.description: Authenticated adapter to RDW information and transaction channels.

dataDependencies.description: System of record for the RDW-derived register.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Source of registration data and the channel for official transactions.

externalSystemsDependingOnThisBrick.description: Plate lookups embedded in third-party software.

bricks.name: Vehicle Identity and Specification
bricks.description: Decodes plates and VINs into a normalised vehicle specification: make, model, edition, factory options, colours, emissions and price lists. Combines RDW technical data with partner sources (SilverDAT VIN information from DAT, Autotelex, Jato).

modules.name: Specification API
modules.description: Returns the normalised specification for a plate or VIN.

layers.description: Orchestration and calculation without durable state.

modules.name: Specification Resolver
modules.description: Merges RDW technical data with partner option data and resolves conflicts.

modules.name: Specification Catalog
modules.description: Normalised model, edition and option catalog with source lineage.

layers.description: Adapters to RDW, data partners, channels and providers.

modules.name: SilverDAT VIN Adapter
modules.description: Fetches factory option data by VIN from DAT (charged per request).

modules.name: Specification Partner Adapter
modules.description: Imports Autotelex and Jato model and price data.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Model editions, options and list prices.

subGroups.name: Vehicle History and Condition
subGroups.description: What happened to the vehicle and what state it is in.

bricks.name: Vehicle History Intelligence
bricks.description: Assembles what happened to a vehicle: international damage history (insurer claims, damage trade, WOK status, BPM changes; NL, DE, EU, US and more), manufacturer maintenance history and NAP odometer judgements. Sold per report to dealers and embedded in Finnik reports.

layers.description: User-facing web, PWA and app surfaces.

modules.name: History Report View
modules.description: Damage and maintenance history report inside the vehicle dossier.

modules.name: History API
modules.description: Orders and returns damage, maintenance and odometer reports.

layers.description: Orchestration and calculation without durable state.

modules.name: History Assembler
modules.description: Queries sources in parallel, de-duplicates events and applies the no-damage-no-charge rule.

modules.name: History Event Store
modules.description: Normalised damage, maintenance and odometer events per VIN with source and date.

layers.description: Adapters to RDW, data partners, channels and providers.

modules.name: Damage Source Adapter
modules.description: Connects international insurer and damage-trade databases.

modules.name: NAP Odometer Adapter
modules.description: Reads Nationale Autopas odometer judgements via RDW.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Claims and damage records by plate or VIN.

bricks.name: EV Battery State of Health
bricks.description: Measures and reports the battery condition of used electric vehicles so dealers can price and sell them with confidence. Reads diagnostic data via a DoIP/OBD dongle and produces a certificate for the buyer.

layers.description: User-facing web, PWA and app surfaces.

modules.name: SoH Certificate View
modules.description: Battery health certificate in the dossier and for buyers.

layers.description: Orchestration and calculation without durable state.

modules.name: SoH Interpreter
modules.description: Converts raw diagnostic readings into a health percentage and range estimate per model.

modules.name: SoH Result Store
modules.description: Battery measurements and certificates per VIN.

layers.description: Adapters to RDW, data partners, channels and providers.

modules.name: Diagnostic Dongle Adapter
modules.description: Receives readings from the diagnostic dongle (Moba DoIP).

bricks.name: Damage Calculation
bricks.description: Estimates repair cost from photos and part catalogues so dealers and lease companies can price repairs into purchase decisions. Delivered with DAT Nederland: SilverDAT Calculate and its AI successor weDAT damage calculation.

layers.description: User-facing web, PWA and app surfaces.

modules.name: Damage Capture
modules.description: Photo-guided damage capture and estimate review.

modules.name: Damage Case Store
modules.description: Calculations, photos and estimates per vehicle.

layers.description: Adapters to RDW, data partners, channels and providers.

modules.name: weDAT Adapter
modules.description: Sends photos and VIN to DAT AI damage calculation and receives repair estimates.

brickDependencies.description: Exact edition and options for part prices.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Parts, labour times and AI recognition.

subGroups.name: Market, Value and Tax
subGroups.description: What the vehicle is worth and what tax applies.

bricks.name: Market and Transaction Data Lake
bricks.description: Collects national and international used-car advertisements, RDW ownership changes and more than 30 years of vehicle and transaction history into an analysable market dataset: asking prices, days-to-sell, supply and demand per model and region.

modules.name: Market Query API
modules.description: Comparable listings, price distributions and stand-time per segment.

modules.name: Advertisement Harvester
modules.description: Collects advertisements from national and international portals daily.

modules.name: Ownership Change Ingest
modules.description: Turns RDW ownership changes into sale events.

layers.description: Orchestration and calculation without durable state.

modules.name: Listing Matcher
modules.description: Matches adverts to plates/specifications and detects when a car is sold.

modules.name: Market Warehouse
modules.description: Historical adverts, sales and transactions by model, edition and region.

layers.description: Adapters to RDW, data partners, channels and providers.

modules.name: Portal Data Adapter
modules.description: Data agreements and collectors for advertising portals.

bricks.name: Valuation Engine
bricks.description: Calculates trade-in, retail and maximum purchase values per vehicle from specification, mileage, history, options and live market comparables. Shared by Occasion Manager, Finnik Zakelijk taxation reports, XRAY valuations and remarketing.

modules.name: Valuation API
modules.description: Returns retail, trade and maximum purchase values with confidence and comparables.

modules.name: Model Retrainer
modules.description: Retrains depreciation curves weekly and back-tests against realised sales.

layers.description: Orchestration and calculation without durable state.

modules.name: Valuation Calculator
modules.description: Applies the valuation model to a vehicle context.

modules.name: Valuation Model Store
modules.description: Versioned depreciation curves, option values and correction factors.

modules.name: Valuation Ledger
modules.description: Every issued valuation with inputs and model version for audit and accuracy tracking.

bricks.name: BPM and Vehicle Tax Calculation
bricks.description: Calculates Dutch BPM (registration tax) for imported vehicles and remaining BPM for exports, using forfaitaire tables, valuation reports or the koerslijst method, and produces taxation reports that importers file with the Tax Authority. Strengthened by the XRAY Automotive acquisition (2026).

layers.description: User-facing web, PWA and app surfaces.

modules.name: BPM API
modules.description: BPM calculations and taxation report orders.

modules.name: Taxation Workbench
modules.description: Appraisers complete inspections and sign taxation reports.

layers.description: Orchestration and calculation without durable state.

modules.name: BPM Rules Engine
modules.description: Versioned BPM tariffs, CO2 brackets and depreciation methods per year.

modules.name: Taxation Case Store
modules.description: Inspections, photos, damage notes and signed reports.

layers.description: Adapters to RDW, data partners, channels and providers.

modules.name: Tax Filing Export
modules.description: Exports reports in the format importers submit to the Belastingdienst.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Rules and filing format for BPM.

rootGroups.name: Dealer Operations (MijnVWE)
rootGroups.description: The modular dealer platform from purchase to delivery.

bricks.name: Vehicle Dossier and Workflow Hub
bricks.description: The MijnVWE core: a dossier per vehicle that collects data, reports, documents and actions from purchase to delivery, and launches RDW transactions, advertising, reports and paperwork from one place.

layers.description: User-facing web, PWA and app surfaces.

modules.name: Dossier Workspace
modules.description: mijn.vwe.nl vehicle dossier with actions and timeline.

modules.name: Dossier BFF
modules.description: Aggregates data, reports and module actions for the dossier.

layers.description: Orchestration and calculation without durable state.

modules.name: Dossier Orchestrator
modules.description: Routes dossier actions to modules and records outcomes.

modules.name: Dossier Store
modules.description: Vehicle dossiers, timeline events and attached documents per dealer.

bricks.name: Occasion Manager Stock and Pricing
bricks.description: Used-car stock management with market data: stock list, signal list for slow movers, pricing advice, buying advice with maximum purchase price, auction bid limits and import checks. Runs as a web app and PWA for iOS and Android.

modules.name: Stock and Signal List
modules.description: Stock overview with price position, stand-time and signals.

modules.name: Buying PWA
modules.description: Scan a plate on the lot or at auction and see maximum purchase price.

modules.name: Stock BFF
modules.description: Stock, signals and buying advice for web and PWA.

modules.name: Signal Generator
modules.description: Nightly recomputes price position and raises stand-time and price signals.

layers.description: Orchestration and calculation without durable state.

modules.name: Pricing and Buying Advisor
modules.description: Combines valuation, market position and target margin into price and bid advice.

modules.name: Stock Store
modules.description: Dealer stock items, cost, target margin, price history and signals.

bricks.name: Trade-in Appraisal Reports
bricks.description: Finnik Zakelijk taxation and purchase reports: a guided trade-in inspection that combines RDW, NAP, manufacturer, SilverDAT, damage and market-price data into a value and a printable report for the customer. Available on the web and in the Finnik app business tab.

layers.description: User-facing web, PWA and app surfaces.

modules.name: Appraisal Web
modules.description: Appraisal form and report on the web.

modules.name: Finnik Business Tab

modules.name: Appraisal Composer
modules.description: Pulls specification, history and valuation into a single report.

modules.name: Appraisal Store
modules.description: Appraisals, photos, condition notes and offers.

modules.name: Finance Quote Widget
modules.description: Monthly payment on website and in quotes.

bricks.name: RDW Transaction Services
bricks.description: Official RDW transactions for the trade: registration in a new name (tenaamstellen), indemnification (vrijwaren, ORV/ORVB2B), license plate applications, APK and tachograph/LPG sign-off, dismantling, mileage registration and driving licence checks; each charged per transaction.

bricks.name: Plates and Materials Webshop
bricks.description: Webshop and HQ counter for trade materials: license plates, export plates, stickers, safes and the export shop, plus short-term insurance products (green card) sold alongside.

layers.description: User-facing web, PWA and app surfaces.

modules.name: Trade Desk
modules.description: Back office for document specialists and the HQ counter.

bricks.name: Change-of-Ownership Lead Scoring
bricks.description: Data-science model that predicts which vehicle owners are likely to change cars in the next one to two months, delivered as lead lists to dealers and importers for timely outreach within privacy rules.

modules.name: Score API

modules.name: Score Store
